How this works (30 seconds to read).
Each screen has one 3 second recording from the NTU forest, and one or two reference recordings of the bird BirdNET thinks it is. Listen to both. Then answer one question: does our recording sound like the reference?
You are not asked to know any bird. Just compare. Press 1 only when you would bet on it; 2 if it sounds right but you have some doubt; 3 if you hear a bird but cannot tell whether it is this one. 3 is a fine answer. Keys 1 2 3 4 5 answer, space replays ours, r plays the reference, c plays with 5 s of context, backspace goes back one clip so you can change an answer (undo), s skips a clip for now (skipped clips come back at the end). Your progress saves itself; you can close this and come back.
